name: Mixed Berry Bright Sorbet
desc: A light, tart Ninja Creami sorbet built on strawberries and peaches.

source.evidence: Searched Ninja Creami mixed berry sorbet recipes (Food Banjo, I Dream of Ice Cream, Detoxinista, Recipes From A Pantry); none use this fruit combination and gram ratio, which reads as the owner's own formula.

ingredients.raw: 250 g frozen mixed fruit, mostly strawberries and peaches
100 g seedless watermelon, cubed (or mango for a less icy result)
ingredients.note: or mango for a less icy result

ingredients.raw: 1-2 tbsp water or fruit juice, for re-spinning

steps: Blend the frozen fruit, watermelon, sugar, lemon juice and vodka (if using) until smooth and the sugar has dissolved.
Refrigerate about 30 minutes, then pour into a Ninja Creami pint container, no higher than the max fill line.
Lid the pint and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours, until solid.
Spin on the Sorbet setting. If it is crumbly, add 1-2 tbsp water or juice and Re-spin.
